summary: MasterBeef Group filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its entry into a franchise agreement to develop premium gelato shops in Hong Kong. The company plans to open the first Thailand gelato shop in summer 2026, with potential further expansion based on performance. No financial terms, deal structure, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine business expansion announcement, not a special situation. No regulatory clock or activist involvement. Filing is a routine current report on business operations and thus does not trigger special-situation classification.
